text: City Council has authorized the City Clerk to shortlist, interview and recommend candidates to Community Councils for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board. This report recommends one candidate for appointment to the board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed Pui See Ho to the Moss Park Arena Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 2, 2030, and until a successor is appointed. 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1a and 1b to the report (June 19, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Moss Park Arena.
